# Kozuki Clan

![](../../assets/mods/hakirework.png){ .entry-page-icon }

[All bloodlines](index.md)

You inherit the [Voice of All Things](../haki.md#voice-of-all-things) and can read Poneglyphs with an empty hand. This includes the Road Poneglyph readings tracked by the pack. See [Oden Two-Sword Style](../../reference/content/hakirework/schools/oden_nitoryu.md).
